== Title ==
<span lang="ja">クロア・スラッグ</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-53o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">場の自分の側に配備する。戦闘の際、１フォース消費して、合計能力値を１減らすごとに、合計戦力に＋１できる。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ノーハオンの沼に住む、猛毒を持つ怪物のデジャリックホログラム。鋭い嗅覚と視覚を持つ猛獣。卵生で、数百もの肉食の幼虫が誕生する。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' K'lor'slug.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on your side of the table. In battle, you may use 1 Force and add 1 to total power for each point by which you reduce total ability.

'''Lore:''' A dejarik hologram of a highly venomous monster that lives in the swamps of Noe'ha'on. It has keen senses of smell and sight. It lays eggs that produce hundreds of carnivorous young.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 3
* '''Uniqueness:''' Unique (one marker)

Remaining printed symbols and statistics await verification.<ref name="jp-face" />
